description: This file defines API endpoints for managing permissions within a role-based access control (RBAC) system. It includes route handlers for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting permissions, with associated permission checks, audit logging, and data validation using Pydantic. It uses FastAPI for routing and dependency injection, SQLAlchemy for database operations, and models/ schemas to represent permission data.

classes.name: PermissionUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for permission update payload, allowing optional modification of name and description.
